jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Great company. Great people. Great opportunities.

If you’d like the chance to make your mark with the world’s largest equipment rental provider, come build your future with United Rentals!

As the Treasury Analyst , you will support the organization’s global Treasury operations by calculating the daily cash position, analyzing working capital, and adhere to accurate execution of treasury transactions across the company’s banking structure. This role partners with internal business partners to enhance operational efficiency, and administers user access on banking platforms, Kyriba and other treasury systems. You will also assist with cash forecasting, as well as debt, and treasury reporting while ensuring compliance with internal controls and Treasury policies.

In addition, the role provides analytical insights to treasury leadership and supports strategic initiatives, including capital allocation, system improvements, and special projects.

What you’ll do:
Determine daily liquidity needs and assist with cash forecasting:
- Execute daily cash positioning

- Ensure adequate liquidity for operational needs while optimizing excess cash deployment

- Maintain, and enhance cash forecasting models

- Incorporate known and estimated cash flows into forecasts to ensure accuracy and visibility, including all wire activity

- Partner with Treasury Manager on borrowing, investing, and funding decisions, ensuring all decisions adhere to bank cutoff times

- Monitor daily bank account activity and resolve discrepancies

- Reconcile forecasted to actual cash activity and analyze variances to improve forecast accuracy

- Partner with business partners to align forecasts with business activity

- Identify trends and provide insights into liquidity and working capital performance

Support debt, foreign exchange, commodity hedging, reporting, M&A, and controls:
- Execute, confirm, and track foreign exchange transactions, ensuring timely and accurate settlement

- Prepare treasury reporting for senior leadership and external stakeholders, cost of debt analysis, bank fee analysis, and month end reporting/ GL coding for accounting,

- Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and treasury policies and procedures

- Assist internal and external audit data requests submissions, ensuring timely and accurate responses

- Participate in system implementations and process improvements,

- Provide analytical support for treasury and broader corporate finance initiatives

- Perform ad hoc analysis to support leadership decision-making

Collect, review and process wire activity:
- Monitoring Wires inbox, ensuring timely and accurate wire execution while ensuring proper approvals and supporting documentation are provided

- Process critical payments a day in advance of due date, including debt principal, interest expense, FX, dividend, and share repurchase

- Confirm receipt of all debt, interest, and dividend payments with agent

- Validate wires debit as expected status and troubleshoot issues with banks and internal teams to resolve any potential issues

- Support process improvements to enhance payment efficiency and controls

Treasury systems, banking structure, and administration:
- Serve as system administrator for treasury systems (e.g., Kyriba) and banking platforms, monitoring Bank Admin mailbox

- Assist in maintaining banking and Treasury system user access, roles, and controls in compliance with SOX requirements, ensuring timely deactivation of users

- Help manage bank account database and account map structures, openings/closures, and complete bank documentation updates as needed while adhering to all banking resolution mandates

- Maintain process documentation and update as necessary

- Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related business field

- 0-2 years of analytical experience in a corporate finance or accounting function

- Strong analytical, financial modeling, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Word, PowerPoint, Google Workspace

- Financial reporting or data visualization tools preferred

- Ability to work accurately under time-sensitive deadlines, prioritize multiple activities, and maintain effective controls over cash movement and banking administration

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize analysis clearly for treasury leadership, business partners, banks, auditors, and other stakeholders

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate across functions, support change initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve treasury processes and reporting

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Great company. Great people. Great opportunities.

If you’d like the chance to make your mark with the world’s largest equipment rental provider, come build your future with United Rentals!

The Operations Manager – Matting Solutions will oversee the operations of a yard within a defined coverage area, ensuring accurate inventory management and exceptional customer service. This role involves managing Matting inventory, quotes, yard logistics and freight, and maintaining precise billing and inventory records. The Manager will engage with customers, particularly UR branch areas, to promote and service different types of mats and other products.

Formerly YAK ACCESS, Matting Solutions is now part of the United Rentals Team and is one of North America’s leading providers of right-of-way access solutions. From pipelines to power lines to civil projects, we offer unmatched expertise in total access planning, clearing, site work and restoration services.

What you’ll do:
Yard Operations Management:
- Supervise all operations within the yard, ensuring smooth and efficient processes.
- Maintain accurate inventory records, ensuring all items are correctly logged and tracked.
- Ensure the yard is organized, safe, and operates within compliance standards.
- Oversee yard profit and loss statement, ensuring effective leadership and cost control
- Complete and receive opportunities from the sales team for quotes on products and services.
- Provide finalized quotes for opportunities to the sales team or directly to customers, ensuring accuracy and competitiveness.
- Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and tailor quotes to meet those needs.

Customer Engagement:
- Visit all UR sites within the designated area to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
- Promote our local mat services and products, discussing various mat types and their applications.
- Cater to the specific needs of UR branch areas and other regional customers, providing tailored solutions and exceptional service.

Logistics Coordination:
- Oversee the loading and unloading of trucks, ensuring all processes are performed safely and efficiently.
- Coordinate with drivers and logistics personnel to ensure timely and accurate delivery and receipt of goods.

Inventory and Billing Management:
- Ensure all inventory movements are accurately recorded in the system.
- Manage billing inputs, ensuring all tickets and records are correct and up-to-date.
- Monitor and report on inventory levels, ensuring adequate stock is maintained to meet customer demands.

Leadership & Supervision:
- Motivate, coach and train personnel.
- Employee communication and satisfaction, ensure compliance with processes and policies and provide guidance and coaching.
- Schedule personnel and maintain accurate and up-to-date time & attendance records.
- Resolve issues where staff needs assistance – following the established escalation process.
- Coordinate new hire on-boarding and employee on-going training.
- Maintain productive labor relations with union steward and ensure compliance with labor agreement in force.
- Provide regular performance feedback. Reward and recognize employees to reinforce positive behaviors.
- Promptly develop and present individualized Performance Improvement Plans as needed.
- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree preferred
- 3-5 years proven experience in yard operations management or a similar role
- Strong understanding of inventory management and logistics coordination
- Excellent customer service and communication skills
- Ability to travel regularly within a 200-mile radius
- Proficiency in relevant billing and inventory management systems
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
